create_ZImageControlNetPipeline: create a ZImageControlNetPipeline with a ZImageControlNetModel for controlled image generation
run_pipeline_call: run the ZImageControlNetPipeline __call__ method to generate images from a text prompt and control image
encode_prompt_text: encode text prompts into prompt embeddings using the pipeline's encode_prompt method
prepare_control_image: prepare a control image for the pipeline by preprocessing and encoding it into latent space
calculate_shift_timestep: calculate the shift parameter for the scheduler based on image sequence length
